from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FiscalYearRevenue(BaseModel):
    """A specific revenue figure reported for a fiscal year in a single document."""
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year the revenue amount corresponds to (e.g., '2022')")
    revenue_amount: float = Field(description="The reported revenue amount for the fiscal year")
    line_item_label: str = Field(description="The specific line item label as written in the report (e.g., 'Consolidated revenue')")
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency code or symbol for the amounts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted revenue instances from the current document."""
    fiscal_year_revenues: list[FiscalYearRevenue]
